pam-mvddoybt.text:
Team, please update the verification logic on `/admin/customers` to support Toggle / Unverify functionality:

---

### 1. Allow Toggle on Verified Badges:
Currently, clicking only verifies the user. Update the badge interaction so that clicking on a "Verified" badge allows the admin to Unverify the user:

- In `CUSTOMER` and `PHONE` columns:
  - If status is `Verified` (Green): Make it clickable (hover shows tooltip: "Click to Unverify").
  - Clicking a green `Verified` badge opens a confirmation modal:
    - Title: "Unverify Customer Email?" (or Phone)
    - Message: "Are you sure you want to mark <email/phone> as unverified for <Customer Name>?"
    - Confirm Button: "Yes, Unverify" (Amber/Red button)
    - Cancel Button: "Cancel"

---

### 2. Update Backend RPC & Handlers:
Ensure the database handler supports setting verification back to `false`:

```sql
-- Update public.admin_verify_customer to handle unverify:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_verify_customer(
  target_user_id UUID,
  verify_type TEXT, -- 'email' or 'phone'
  is_verified BOOLEAN
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF verify_type = 'email' THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET 
      email_verified = is_verified,
      email_verified_at = CASE WHEN is_verified THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = target_user_id;

    -- If unverified, clear auth confirmation
    IF NOT is_verified THEN
      UPDATE auth.users
      SET email_confirmed_at = NULL
      WHERE id = target_user_id;
    ELSE
      UPDATE auth.users
      SET email_confirmed_at = COALESCE(email_confirmed_at, NOW())
      WHERE id = target_user_id;
    END IF;

  ELSIF verify_type = 'phone' THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET 
      phone_verified = is_verified,
      phone_verified_at = CASE WHEN is_verified THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = target_user_id;

    IF NOT is_verified THEN
      UPDATE auth.users
      SET phone_confirmed_at = NULL
      WHERE id = target_user_id;
    ELSE
      UPDATE auth.users
      SET phone_confirmed_at = COALESCE(phone_confirmed_at, NOW())
      WHERE id = target_user_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'user_id', target_user_id, 'type', verify_type, 'verified', is_verified);
END;
$$;
